name: TV Readability Boost
description: Enlarges text and improves readability for TV viewing distance - trigger manually on any page

params.css: html { font-size: 22px !important; } body { line-height: 1.7 !important; max-width: 1200px !important; margin: 0 auto !important; padding: 20px 40px !important; } p, li, td, th, span, div, a { font-size: inherit !important; line-height: inherit !important; } h1 { font-size: 2.2em !important; } h2 { font-size: 1.8em !important; } h3 { font-size: 1.5em !important; } a { text-decoration: underline !important; } img { max-width: 100% !important; height: auto !important; }
